summary: Tomb Raider entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Tomb Raider (2013)
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with GOTY/definitive content installed

emulation.notes: Native PC route; use mobile/Switch only for port comparison.

primary.version: Windows PC version with GOTY/definitive content installed
primary.why: This is the 2013 Survivor reboot, not the 1996 classic. Windows has the highest capture ceiling, and no sourced platform-exclusive story or mission content requires a second route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows build with all owned GOTY/Definitive Survivor Trilogy content installed, current patches, and max stable settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this reboot with the 1996 classic. Definitive Edition ports change presentation, but Windows remains the highest-ceiling route.

entries.title: Tomb Raider (1996)

emulation.notes: Original PlayStation/Saturn emulation is only for historical comparison.

primary.why: The remaster gives the strongest fidelity path and includes the Unfinished Business expansion content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the remaster, switch between classic/remastered visuals only as needed, and include Unfinished Business after the base game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Classic visual mode is useful for historical comparison, but the remaster remains the primary route.

entries.title: Tomb Raider II

emulation.notes: Original PlayStation emulation is optional historical context.

primary.why: The remaster is the best fidelity route and includes The Golden Mask expansion.
primary.how_to_play: Play the base game in the remaster, then play The Golden Mask from the same package.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use classic visuals only for comparison shots.

entries.title: Tomb Raider III

emulation.notes: Use original hardware/emulation only if researching historical differences.

primary.why: The remaster includes The Lost Artifact expansion, making it the strongest fidelity-plus-completeness route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tomb Raider III and The Lost Artifact inside the remastered collection.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original PC/PlayStation versions remain comparison material, not the primary play path.

entries.title: Rise of the Tomb Raider
entries.definitive_edition: Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Celebration

emulation.notes: Native PC route.

primary.version: Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Celebration / Windows complete install
primary.why: Windows with 20 Year Celebration/season-pass content installed is the highest-fidelity complete route. The Switch 2 release is current and complete but not a higher-ceiling capture target than PC.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows build with 20 Year Celebration content and all owned DLC installed; verify Blood Ties and endurance/co-op modes before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Verify installed DLC/season-pass content; Switch 2 is a current complete console route but not the PC-fidelity primary.

entries.title: Shadow of the Tomb Raider
entries.definitive_edition: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition

emulation.notes: Native PC route.

primary.version: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition / Windows
primary.why: The Windows Definitive Edition has the highest configurable fidelity and bundles the DLC tomb/mission packs; PS5 and Xbox Series updates do not add exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows Definitive Edition or base game with all DLC installed, apply current patches, and capture at max stable settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: DLC tombs, side missions, weapons, outfits, and skills are entitlement checks if using a non-Definitive install.

entries.title: Tomb Raider Anniversary

emulation.notes: Native PC for primary; use Dolphin or Wii hardware only for the Wii-exclusive interactions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows max settings; Wii secondary via Dolphin upscaling

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity full-campaign route. Wii has exclusive motion-control first-person puzzle interactions, so it is a short secondary curiosity rather than the main run.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version with widescreen/current compatibility fixes as needed; sample Wii only for Wii-exclusive puzzle interactions.

secondary.exclusive_content: Wii-exclusive first-person motion-control puzzle interactions such as flashlight, pickaxe, rubbings, and mechanism assembly.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the Wii-exclusive interactions in affected levels rather than replaying the whole campaign.
secondary.why: They are platform-exclusive interactions, but not separate story missions, so Windows remains the primary.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS3 Trilogy collection is not a fuller route; Wii-specific interactions are control/puzzle variants rather than extra story levels.

entries.remaster_caveats: Test next-generation content settings and current compatibility before capture; PS3 Trilogy is a collection route, not a fuller version.

entries.title: Tomb Raider Reloaded

emulation.notes: Use real mobile hardware where possible; Android emulator capture may not reflect device performance.

primary.why: Reloaded is a mobile-first iOS/Android game; a high-end Android device or Android capture setup is the most flexible archive route, while iOS has the same sourced content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Android release on a supported high-end device or compatible capture setup, and document app version/server availability before recording.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile live-service availability and chapter/content state can change; document app version and server state.

entries.title: Tomb Raider The Action Adventure

emulation.notes: PC DVD playback is acceptable for capture if the original disc is used.

primary.why: This is an interactive DVD by Bright Entertainment, played with standard DVD audiovisual and remote-control capabilities.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original DVD on a standard DVD player or PC DVD playback setup; capture video output and remote-control prompts.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is sourced; story is based on The Angel of Darkness rather than being that full game.

entries.title: Tomb Raider The Angel of Darkness

emulation.notes: Native Windows remaster; PCSX2 only for original PS2 comparison.

primary.why: The Windows remaster has the highest current fidelity ceiling and restores some content cut during original development, making it the best fidelity-plus-completeness route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered on Windows, apply current patches, and keep original graphics available for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use current patches; original PC/PS2 builds remain useful only for historical comparison.

entries.title: Tomb Raider The Last Revelation

emulation.notes: Native Windows remaster; DuckStation/Flycast only for original-platform comparison.

primary.why: The Windows remaster is the highest-fidelity current route and includes the Times Exclusive bonus level, so fidelity and completeness align.
primary.how_to_play: Use Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered on Windows and include The Times Exclusive level from the remaster after the main campaign.

entries.remaster_caveats: Include The Times Exclusive level; original platform routes are historical comparison paths.

entries.title: Tomb Raider Underworld
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC main campaign plus Xbox 360 DLC episodes

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Xbox hardware/backward compatibility for secondary
emulation.notes: Use native PC for the main run; use Xbox 360 or compatible Xbox ownership route for DLC if available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows max settings for main campaign; Xbox 360 for DLC completeness

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity main-campaign route, but Xbox 360 has two exclusive DLC episodes, so this entry needs a secondary Xbox 360 pass for those episodes only.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version at max stable settings for the campaign, then play Beneath the Ashes and Lara?s Shadow on Xbox 360/Xbox-compatible ownership if available.

secondary.exclusive_content: Exclusive DLC episodes Beneath the Ashes and Lara?s Shadow.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the two DLC episodes after finishing the Windows main campaign.
secondary.why: The DLC episodes were made for Xbox 360 and add standalone post-game content missing from Windows and PlayStation routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS3 Trilogy collection does not include the two Xbox 360-exclusive Underworld DLC episodes.
